sections.name: Hardware control & calibration
intro: Printer-side control, calibration and device actions; most need a connection or feedback from the device.

sections.name: RFID
intro: Needs an R-series printer, which no test device covers; modelled rows are
spec-only. Stage A: ^RS/^RB/^RW settings. Stage B: ^RF write element plus its
password-coupled ^RL. Read-back stays native. ^RM/^RR folded into ^RS,
^RN/~RV dropped from the current guide; all four passthrough only.

commands.title: start label
commands.summary: Starts a new label format. Commands after it define fields, media handling and printer behavior for that label.

commands.title: end label
commands.summary: Closes the current label format and submits it for printing.

commands.title: print width
commands.summary: Sets the printable width in dots. Content beyond that width is clipped by the printer.

commands.title: label length
commands.summary: Sets the label length in dots, defining where the printable format ends.

commands.title: label home origin
commands.summary: Moves the label home position, changing the origin used by later field coordinates.

commands.title: label shift
commands.summary: Applies a horizontal offset to field positions for compatibility with older Zebra formats.

commands.title: label top offset
commands.summary: Adds a vertical offset to the entire format relative to the top edge of the media.

commands.title: units of measure
commands.summary: Sets coordinate units to dots, inches or millimeters, and can scale formats between print resolutions.

commands.title: print mode
commands.summary: Sets the media handling mode after printing, including tear-off, peel-off, cutter, rewind and applicator modes.

commands.title: media type
commands.summary: Selects thermal transfer or direct thermal mode, matching whether the loaded media uses a ribbon.

commands.title: print quantity
commands.summary: Sets print quantity, pause or cut grouping, and copies per serial value.

commands.title: label reverse
commands.summary: Reverses printing for following fields by swapping foreground and background.

commands.title: print orientation
commands.summary: Rotates the complete label format by 180 degrees.

commands.title: print mirror
commands.summary: Mirrors the printable area horizontally.

commands.title: print rate
commands.summary: Sets print speed, slew speed and backfeed speed in inches per second.

commands.title: field origin
commands.summary: Positions the next field from the label home origin using its upper-left corner.

commands.title: field top
commands.summary: Positions the next field from its baseline or barcode edge, giving rotated fields a stable anchor.

commands.title: field data
commands.summary: Provides the content for the current field, including text, barcode data or RFID data.

commands.title: field separator
commands.summary: Terminates the current field definition.

commands.title: field hex indicator
commands.summary: Enables hexadecimal escapes inside field data for binary bytes and reserved command characters.

commands.title: field reverse
commands.summary: Reverses foreground and background for the next field only.

commands.title: field comment
commands.summary: Adds a comment field. The printer ignores its contents through the next field separator.

commands.title: default field rotation
commands.summary: Sets the default field orientation and, on newer firmware, the default justification.

commands.title: multi line text block
commands.summary: Wraps field data inside a fixed-width block with line count, spacing, indent and justification controls.

commands.title: text block
commands.summary: Wraps text inside a fixed-width and fixed-height box, truncating overflow.

commands.title: variable placeholder
commands.summary: Assigns a number to a variable field in stored and recalled formats.

commands.title: variable data
commands.summary: Provides data for a variable field. Unlike ^FD data, it is cleared after the label prints.

commands.title: field number embed character
commands.summary: Sets the character used to embed numbered field values inside another field string.

commands.title: field clock
commands.summary: Sets the markers used for real-time clock tokens inside field data.

commands.title: barcode field default
commands.summary: Sets default barcode module width, wide-to-narrow ratio and height for following barcode fields.

commands.title: PDF417 structured-append origins, ignored elsewhere
commands.summary: Places PDF417 or MicroPDF417 segments at specific origins when one message spans multiple symbols.

commands.title: vertical / reverse field layout
commands.summary: Sets character order for the current field and can add extra character spacing.

commands.title: scalable font 0
commands.summary: Selects resident scalable font 0 for the next field at the requested size and orientation.

commands.title: fonts A to Z and 0 to 9
commands.summary: Selects a resident font by one-character name, with optional orientation, height and width.

commands.title: TrueType reference
commands.summary: Selects a stored font file for the next field, with optional orientation, height and width.

commands.title: change default font
commands.summary: Sets the fallback font, height and width used by text fields that specify none of their own.

commands.title: international encoding
commands.summary: Selects the encoding used to interpret field data, including code pages and UTF-8.

commands.title: advanced text properties
commands.summary: Enables advanced text layout for following fields, including bidirectional text, shaping and OpenType features.

commands.title: font alias
commands.summary: Maps a one-character font name to a stored font file.

commands.title: font cache size
commands.summary: Sets the cache size for rendered scalable glyphs to speed repeated large-font output.

commands.title: font linking
commands.summary: Defines TrueType fallback chains used when the base font lacks a glyph.

commands.title: list font links
commands.summary: Prints a label listing configured font links and their chained fallback faces.

commands.title: download bitmap font
commands.summary: Downloads a bitmap font and its metrics into printer memory.

commands.title: download scalable font
commands.summary: Downloads an encoded scalable Intellifont into printer memory.

commands.title: download TrueType font
commands.summary: Downloads an encoded TrueType font with up to 256 characters into printer memory.

commands.title: download unbounded TrueType
commands.summary: Downloads an encoded TrueType font with more than 256 glyphs into printer memory.

commands.title: download encoding
commands.summary: Downloads an encoding table that maps field-data bytes to Unicode values for TrueType fonts.

commands.title: Code 128
commands.summary: Draws a Code 128 barcode for variable-length ASCII data, with modes for automatic subset switching and UCC/EAN data.

commands.title: Code 39
commands.summary: Draws a Code 39 barcode with an optional Mod 43 check digit.

commands.title: Code 93
commands.summary: Draws a Code 93 barcode, representing full ASCII data through shift characters.

commands.title: Code 11
commands.summary: Draws a Code 11 barcode for digits and hyphens, with optional check digits.

commands.title: Interleaved 2 of 5
commands.summary: Draws an Interleaved 2 of 5 barcode for even-length numeric data, with an optional check digit.

commands.title: Industrial 2 of 5
commands.summary: Draws an Industrial 2 of 5 barcode, a numeric code with data encoded in bars only.

commands.title: Standard 2 of 5
commands.summary: Draws a Standard 2 of 5 barcode, a self-checking numeric code with data encoded in bars only.

commands.title: ANSI Codabar
commands.summary: Draws an ANSI Codabar barcode, also known as USD-4, for library, healthcare and courier labels.

commands.title: LOGMARS
commands.summary: Draws a LOGMARS barcode, the Department of Defense variant of Code 39, and folds lowercase data to uppercase.

commands.title: MSI
commands.summary: Draws an MSI barcode, a Plessey-derived numeric code with selectable check digit schemes.

commands.title: Plessey
commands.summary: Draws a Plessey barcode, an older numeric code with optional check digits.

commands.title: EAN-13
commands.summary: Draws an EAN-13 barcode for retail article numbers and derives the check digit from twelve data digits.

commands.title: EAN-8
commands.summary: Draws an EAN-8 barcode for small retail packages and derives the check digit from seven data digits.

commands.title: UPC-A
commands.summary: Draws a UPC-A barcode for retail packaging from eleven data digits, with optional check digit printing.

commands.title: UPC-E
commands.summary: Draws a UPC-E barcode, the short form of UPC-A. Field data is the full ten-digit manufacturer and product code.

commands.title: GS1 DataBar
commands.summary: Draws a GS1 DataBar symbol with selectable subtype, magnification, height and segment width.

commands.title: Planet Code
commands.summary: Draws a Planet Code postal barcode from digits encoded as tall and short bars.

commands.title: POSTNET / Planet Code / Intelligent Mail
commands.summary: Draws POSTNET, Planet Code or USPS Intelligent Mail as selected by the postal code type.

commands.title: UPC/EAN 2 or 5 digit add-on
commands.summary: Draws a two-digit or five-digit UPC/EAN add-on symbol beside a main barcode.

commands.title: Code 49
commands.summary: Draws a Code 49 stacked barcode with two to eight rows of full ASCII data.

commands.title: QR Code
commands.summary: Draws a QR Code symbol. Command parameters set model, magnification and mask. Field data sets error correction and character mode.

commands.title: Data Matrix
commands.summary: Draws a Data Matrix symbol with configurable element size, quality level and escape handling.

commands.title: PDF417
commands.summary: Draws a PDF417 stacked two-dimensional symbol for large text or binary payloads.

commands.title: MicroPDF417
commands.summary: Draws a MicroPDF417 symbol, a compact PDF417 variant with row-address patterns.

commands.title: Aztec
commands.summary: Draws an Aztec matrix symbol with configurable magnification and error correction.

commands.title: CODABLOCK F
commands.summary: Draws a CODABLOCK symbol in mode A, E or F for larger data payloads.

commands.title: UPS MaxiCode
commands.summary: Draws a UPS MaxiCode symbol with a mode for structured carrier messages or general data.

commands.title: TLC39
commands.summary: Draws a TLC39 telecom label symbol combining Code 39 with a MicroPDF417 component.

commands.title: code validation
commands.summary: When enabled, validates barcode data and parameters and prints INVALID instead of a bad symbol.

commands.title: graphic box
commands.summary: Draws a filled or outlined rectangle. Matching a side to border thickness produces a line.

commands.title: diagonal line
commands.summary: Draws a diagonal line across a given width and height, leaning right or left.

commands.title: ellipse
commands.summary: Draws an ellipse from a width and height in dots, with inward border thickness and black or white output.

commands.title: circle
commands.summary: Draws a circle of the given diameter in dots, with inward border thickness and black or white output.

commands.title: monochrome bitmap
commands.summary: Places a monochrome bitmap at the current field position using ASCII hex, binary or compressed data.

commands.title: graphic symbol
commands.summary: Prints a resident symbol selected by field data, such as copyright or registered trademark.

commands.title: image load
commands.summary: Loads a stored image at the start of a format and anchors it at the label origin.

commands.title: image move
commands.summary: Places a stored image at the current field position without scaling it.

commands.title: delete stored graphics, fonts and formats
commands.summary: Deletes stored graphics, fonts or formats from printer memory, with wildcard support for groups.

commands.title: image save
commands.summary: Saves the current format as a graphic image for fast recall and variable-data overlays.

commands.title: download graphic
commands.summary: Downloads an ASCII-hex graphic into printer memory under a reusable name.

commands.title: abort download
commands.summary: Stops a graphic upload that was interrupted midway and returns the printer to normal operation.

commands.title: download font / graphic
commands.summary: Downloads a graphic, font or certificate into printer memory under a reusable name.

commands.title: erase download graphics
commands.summary: Erases all downloaded graphics from printer memory. Use ^ID to delete selected objects.

commands.title: serial counter with its own start value
commands.summary: Serializes text or barcode field data across labels, using a start value, direction and increment.

commands.title: serial mask over ^FD data
commands.summary: Serializes selected positions in field data using a mask and character sets.

commands.title: store template
commands.summary: Stores the following commands as a reusable format rather than printing them immediately.

commands.title: recall template
commands.summary: Recalls a stored format and supplies values for its numbered placeholder fields.

commands.title: recall graphic
commands.summary: Recalls a stored graphic at the current position with independent horizontal and vertical scaling.

commands.title: media tracking
commands.summary: Selects how the printer detects label boundaries, using gaps, marks or continuous media.

commands.title: maximum label length
commands.summary: Sets the maximum label length the printer searches while calibrating non-continuous media.

commands.title: media feed
commands.summary: Sets the power-up and printhead-close action, including calibration, feed or length measurement.

commands.title: suppress backfeed
commands.summary: Suppresses backfeed for the current label when moving to the tear-off position is unnecessary.

commands.title: maintenance alert
commands.summary: Configures printed maintenance alerts for printhead cleaning or replacement.

commands.title: map clear
commands.summary: Controls whether the label bitmap is cleared after printing or kept for reuse by later labels.

commands.title: maintenance information message
commands.summary: Sets the text shown on maintenance alert labels for printhead cleaning or replacement.

commands.title: mode protection
commands.summary: Locks a control panel setting, such as darkness or calibration, until it is unlocked.

commands.title: printhead cold warning
commands.summary: Enables or disables the printhead-cold warning indicator.

commands.title: media darkness
commands.summary: Adjusts print darkness relative to the printer's current configured darkness.

commands.title: set darkness
commands.summary: Sets absolute print darkness immediately, matching the front-panel darkness setting.

commands.title: reprint after error
commands.summary: Controls whether a label interrupted by media, ribbon or printhead faults is reprinted after recovery.

commands.title: printhead test interval
commands.summary: Schedules periodic printhead element tests by printed-label count and optional element range.

commands.title: tear off adjust
commands.summary: Adjusts the resting tear-off or cut position by a small dot offset after printing.

commands.title: early warning settings
commands.summary: Configures early warning thresholds for media, ribbon and printhead maintenance.

commands.title: change backfeed sequence
commands.summary: Controls backfeed timing around printing and cutting, or turns backfeed off.

commands.title: slew given number of dot rows
commands.summary: Feeds a specified number of blank dot rows at slew speed.

commands.title: slew home
commands.summary: Feeds one blank label after the current format has printed.

commands.title: slew home, immediate
commands.summary: Feeds one blank label as soon as the printer is free, after the current format or while paused.

commands.title: programmable pause
commands.summary: Pauses after the current format prints. Already buffered labels can still print first.

commands.title: pause, immediate
commands.summary: Pauses after the current label finishes. Printing resumes when the pause state is cleared.

commands.title: applicator reprint
commands.summary: Reprints the previous label when applicator reprint mode is enabled.

commands.title: print start
commands.summary: Clears pause mode and resumes printing.

commands.title: cut now, KR403 kiosk only
commands.summary: Runs the cutter immediately on KR403 printers in kiosk print mode.

commands.title: present length addition, KR403 kiosk only
commands.summary: Adds extra eject length to a KR403 kiosk presenter, making printed media easier to take.

commands.title: presenter cycle, KR403 kiosk only
commands.summary: Runs a KR403 presenter cycle, offering printed media for manual removal.

commands.title: set ribbon tension, PAX only
commands.summary: Sets ribbon supply tension on PAX-series printers.

commands.title: set date and time
commands.summary: Sets the printer's real-time clock date and time.

commands.title: date and time format
commands.summary: Selects the date and time format shown on the configuration label and control panel.

commands.title: real-time clock offset
commands.summary: Defines secondary clock offsets from the real-time clock. The offsets are lost when the printer powers off.

commands.title: clock mode and language
commands.summary: Sets when time fields are stamped and selects the language for day and month names.

commands.title: define language
commands.summary: Selects the display language of the printer's control panel from a list that varies by model.

commands.title: encoding table
commands.summary: Selects a stored encoding table used to map field data before printing.

commands.title: set ZPL mode
commands.summary: Selects original ZPL or ZPL II command interpretation for compatibility with older formats.

commands.title: printer name and description
commands.summary: Assigns the printer a network name and a free-text description, both shown on the configuration label and its built-in web page.

commands.title: set password
commands.summary: Sets the four-digit password for the control panel setup menus.

commands.title: configuration update
commands.summary: Saves, restores or resets printer configuration settings.

commands.title: change caret
commands.summary: Changes the format-command prefix character, normally the caret, either globally or for the current format.

commands.title: change delimiter
commands.summary: Changes the parameter delimiter character, normally the comma, either globally or for the current format.

commands.title: change tilde
commands.summary: Changes the immediate-command prefix character, normally the tilde, either globally or for the current format.

commands.title: change memory letter assignment
commands.summary: Remaps printer memory letters so stored objects can keep their existing names.

commands.title: cancel all
commands.summary: Cancels queued formats and the current batch. The label already printing can finish.

commands.title: initialize flash memory
commands.summary: Erases and reinitializes one flash memory device. Losing power during this operation can corrupt storage.

commands.title: reset optional memory
commands.summary: Reinitializes the battery-backed memory card after installation or battery replacement.

commands.title: media sensor calibration
commands.summary: Runs media calibration to measure label length and adjust media and ribbon sensors.

commands.title: enable communications diagnostics
commands.summary: Prints incoming bytes and their hexadecimal values instead of executing them, for host communication diagnostics.

commands.title: disable communications diagnostics
commands.summary: Leaves communications diagnostic mode and returns the printer to normal label printing.

commands.title: set battery condition, PA400 and PT400 only
commands.summary: Sets whether low battery voltage pauses a portable printer or allows printing to continue.

commands.title: graphing sensor calibration
commands.summary: Runs media calibration and prints a sensor profile graph for the media-gap transition.

commands.title: start ZBI
commands.summary: Starts the Zebra BASIC Interpreter on the printer, optionally launching a stored program.

commands.title: set auxiliary port
commands.summary: Configures the auxiliary port for applicator or verifier signals and error handling.

commands.title: sensor select
commands.summary: Selects the media sensor used for tracking, usually reflective or transmissive.

commands.title: set label length
commands.summary: Measures and stores label length, feeding blank labels during the process.

commands.title: dots per millimeter
commands.summary: Sets normal or reduced dots per millimeter. Reduced density doubles the physical size of format coordinates.

commands.title: printhead test fatal
commands.summary: Makes failed printhead element tests halt printing until the printer is reset or tolerant mode is restored.

commands.title: printhead test non-fatal
commands.summary: Allows printing to continue after a failed printhead element test.

commands.title: pause and cancel format
commands.summary: Cancels the next queued format and pauses the printer, one buffered format per command.

commands.title: terminate ZBI
commands.summary: Exits an active Zebra BASIC Interpreter session and returns the port to ZPL processing.

commands.title: power on reset
commands.summary: Reboots the printer firmware and reloads saved communication and configuration defaults.

commands.title: cancel partial format
commands.summary: Cancels the format currently being received without canceling labels already printing.

commands.title: reset advanced counter
commands.summary: Resets a selected printer usage counter, including user or RFID counters.

commands.title: set serial communications
commands.summary: Configures all serial-port communication parameters in one command.

commands.title: set sensor intensity
commands.summary: Overrides transmissive sensor intensity or baseline values normally set by calibration.

commands.title: start print at dot row, throughput hint only
commands.summary: Starts printing before the full format has arrived to improve throughput on complex labels.

commands.title: halt ZebraNet alert
commands.summary: Disables a specific ZebraNet alert condition and destination.

commands.title: set printhead resistance
commands.summary: Sets the printhead resistance value used for burn-energy calculations.

commands.title: set media sensors
commands.summary: Sets media sensor thresholds, label length and LED intensities normally determined by calibration.

commands.title: set ZebraNet alert
commands.summary: Enables a ZebraNet alert for a specific condition and destination.

commands.title: transfer object
commands.summary: Copies stored objects between printer memory devices, with wildcard support for groups.

commands.title: print configuration label
commands.summary: Prints a configuration label with sensor, network, firmware and memory information.

commands.title: print directory label
commands.summary: Prints a directory label for stored objects, resident fonts or available barcodes.

commands.title: write query
commands.summary: Prints requested service information, such as odometer or printhead history, on a label.

commands.title: cutter and presenter settings, KR403 only
commands.summary: Configures KR403 kiosk presenter settings, including cut length, cut margin, retract timeout and loop length.

commands.title: set dynamic media calibration
commands.summary: Controls dynamic recalibration of label length and sensor threshold after power-up or media-compartment open.

commands.title: decommissioning mode
commands.summary: Starts decommissioning mode to prepare a printer for resale or recycling.

commands.title: printer sleep, PA400 and PT400 only
commands.summary: Sets automatic sleep shutdown after an idle period, with options for queued labels.

commands.title: eject or retract a presented page, KR403 only
commands.summary: Ejects or retracts media already presented by a KR403 kiosk presenter.

commands.title: kill battery
commands.summary: Runs battery discharge mode on portable printers for pack conditioning.

commands.title: battery status, mobile printers only
commands.summary: Returns battery and printhead power readings from mobile printers.

commands.title: printhead diagnostic
commands.summary: Returns printhead diagnostic data, including temperatures, element test results, darkness and speed.

commands.title: host format
commands.summary: Returns a stored ZPL format from printer memory to the host.

commands.title: host graphic
commands.summary: Returns a stored graphic image from printer memory to the host.

commands.title: configuration label return
commands.summary: Returns the printer's current configuration as readable text over the host port.

commands.title: host identification
commands.summary: Returns printer identity data, including model, firmware, resolution, memory and installed options.

commands.title: host RAM status
commands.summary: Returns total, maximum available and currently free printer memory in kilobytes.

commands.title: host query
commands.summary: Returns requested status, identity, odometer or maintenance data to the host.

commands.title: host status return
commands.summary: Returns host-status strings for interface, media, pause state, label length and buffered formats.

commands.title: host linked fonts list
commands.summary: Returns the font link table to the host, listing base fonts and fallback faces.

commands.title: ZebraNet alert configuration
commands.summary: Returns the configured ZebraNet alerts, including conditions, destinations and set or clear flags.

commands.title: host verification
commands.summary: Returns data from a numbered field to the host, with an optional byte limit.

commands.title: host directory
commands.summary: Returns a directory listing for a memory device, including remaining free space.

commands.title: upload graphics
commands.summary: Returns a stored graphic to the host in a downloadable file format.

commands.title: display description information
commands.summary: Returns printer description XML for settings, object directory or status.

commands.title: read / write RFID
commands.summary: Reads from or writes to an RFID tag, including data format, memory bank and access password.

commands.title: get tag ID
commands.summary: Reads the current RFID tag ID for use in label data or a host reply.

commands.title: enable motion, pre-Link-OS, folded into ^RS
commands.summary: Controls media movement during legacy RFID operations. Link-OS formats use ^RS instead.

commands.title: detect multiple tags, pre-Link-OS, absent from guide
commands.summary: Detects more than one RFID tag in the encoding field and can void labels with stray tags nearby.

commands.title: RFID retries, pre-Link-OS, folded into ^RS
commands.summary: Sets retry count for legacy RFID reads or writes. Link-OS formats use ^RS instead.

commands.title: define EPC data structure
commands.summary: Defines the bit layout used to encode RFID EPC fields on a tag.

commands.title: RFID setup
commands.summary: Sets RFID options for following labels, including tag type, programming position, failure handling and VOID bar length.

commands.title: read tag
commands.summary: Reads tag data into a label field in legacy RFID formats.

commands.title: legacy RFID write, superseded by ^RF
commands.summary: Writes tag data in legacy RFID formats. ^RF covers read, write and password handling.

commands.title: read unique chip serialisation
commands.summary: Builds an EPC serial number from the tag ID and writes it into the EPC low bits.

commands.title: report encoding result, pre-Link-OS, absent from guide
commands.summary: Returns each RFID encoding outcome to the host, letting software distinguish good tags from voided labels.

commands.title: set read and write power
commands.summary: Sets RFID read and write power when calibration does not produce usable values.

commands.title: lock / permalock tag memory
commands.summary: Locks RFID tag memory, either reversibly or permanently, to prevent later writes.

commands.title: calibrate RFID tag position
commands.summary: Runs RFID calibration and returns position, antenna and power settings to the host.

commands.title: RFID data log
commands.summary: Returns the RFID operation log, including position, antenna, power level and outcome.

commands.title: check for wired print server at boot
commands.summary: Selects whether the printer checks for a wired print server during startup.

commands.title: select wired / wireless primary device
commands.summary: Selects the primary network device, wired or wireless.

commands.title: network connect, legacy RS-485 only
commands.summary: Addresses one printer on a legacy RS-485 multidrop line by network ID.

commands.title: network ID, legacy RS-485 only
commands.summary: Assigns the network ID used to address a printer on a legacy RS-485 multidrop line.

commands.title: set SNMP
commands.summary: Sets SNMP identity and community strings for the printer.

commands.title: boot settings source: printer vs print server
commands.summary: Selects whether boot-time network settings come from the printer or attached print server.

commands.title: set all transparent, legacy RS-485 only
commands.summary: Switches all printers on a legacy multidrop line into transparent receive mode.

commands.title: set SMTP
commands.summary: Configures SMTP server and domain settings for print-server email alerts.

commands.title: set connected printer transparent, legacy RS-485 only
commands.summary: Switches the addressed legacy multidrop printer into transparent receive mode.

commands.title: web auth timeout
commands.summary: Sets how long an authenticated IP address can access printer web pages before reauthentication.

commands.title: set client identifier
commands.summary: Sets the DHCP client identifier form and value for the print server.

commands.title: change network settings
commands.summary: Configures IP address, subnet mask and gateway for a printer network interface.

commands.title: change wired network settings
commands.summary: Configures wired print-server IP settings, timeouts and raw port for older firmware.

commands.title: set antenna parameters
commands.summary: Selects receive and transmit antennas for the wireless radio.

commands.title: set WEP mode, obsolete, use ^WX
commands.summary: Configures obsolete WEP security and key material for older wireless firmware.

commands.title: set LEAP, obsolete, use ^WX
commands.summary: Configures obsolete Cisco LEAP authentication for older wireless firmware.

commands.title: set wireless password
commands.summary: Sets the password for wireless settings on the printer control panel.

commands.title: set transmit rate
commands.summary: Configures 802.11b data rates and transmit power on older wireless print servers.

commands.title: set wireless radio card values
commands.summary: Configures wireless network name, radio mode, preamble length and keep-alive behavior.

commands.title: configure wireless security
commands.summary: Configures wireless security mode, keys and credentials in one command.

commands.title: print network configuration label
commands.summary: Prints a network configuration label while the printer is idle.

commands.title: reset wireless radio card
commands.summary: Restarts the wireless radio card and print server, causing the radio to rejoin the network.
